# Testdata

Top-level fixture areas:

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `applications/` | Small Application render fixtures for direct, directory, Kustomize, Helm, and end-to-end cases. |
| `appset-git-directories/` | Git directories ApplicationSet fixture with generated app paths. |
| `fixtures/` | Portable smoke-test repositories with current and baseline trees. |
| `home-ops-patterns/` | Synthetic home-ops-style patterns for chart, ApplicationSet, remote Kustomize, and nested app behavior. |
| `renovate-diff/` | Baseline and current trees for dependency-update diff coverage. |
| `settings/` | Argo CD settings and repository Secret metadata fixtures. |
